title: The canon and how it is organized
note: The Protestant Bible has 66 books: 39 in the Old Testament and 27 in the New. Catholic Bibles add seven deuterocanonical books (Tobit, Judith, 1 and 2 Maccabees, Wisdom, Sirach, Baruch) and additions to Esther and Daniel, for 73; Orthodox Bibles include a few more. Christians usually group the Old Testament as Law, History, Wisdom and Prophets.
